source_row.rationale: The American Heart Association lists an average resting heart-rate range of about 100–190 beats/min for infants. A rate of 140/min falls within that range; 80/min is below it, while 215/min and 240/min are clearly above it.
source_row.source_detail: American Heart Association — Treating Arrhythmias in Children, Normal ranges for children: infant resting heart rate averages 100–190 beats/min.
